authority_boundary: Private-run handoff manifests declare expected private evidence slots only.

Private-run handoff manifests do not approve live work, select endpoints, replay evidence, monitor peers, probe peers, open sockets, copy files, discover devices, send gossip, use ADB, or launch apps.
Private-run handoff manifests do not carry gossip bodies, commands, shell text, ADB targets, pairing material, install requests, launch requests, or private endpoint values.
